configure_rtmdet_instance_segmentation: configure RTMDet instance segmentation model with bbox head, loss functions, and test config for COCO dataset
build_train_pipeline: build a two-stage training pipeline with CachedMosaic, CachedMixUp augmentation and pipeline switch at epoch 280
setup_model_bbox_head: setup RTMDetInsSepBNHead bbox head with QualityFocalLoss, GIoULoss, and DiceLoss for instance segmentation
configure_evaluator: configure validation and test evaluator with bbox and segmentation metrics for COCO evaluation
setup_custom_hooks: setup EMAHook for exponential moving average and PipelineSwitchHook for two-stage training pipeline switching
